title: The access-review assistant showed another team's reviews
scenario: After release 2.3.0 managers see other teams' access reviews in the Lighthouse assistant, and Bedrock input tokens climb all day until the nightly deploy. On-call blames a temperature change and wants a stricter system prompt. Find the real cause in the logs and code and fix session state.
task: Correlate session ids, agent object ids and token counts in the logs
Find the state shared across sessions in service/app.py
Per-session agents with an LRU bound, idle expiry and thread safety
Explain why prompt and temperature cannot cause or fix this
acceptance: Sessions isolated, continuity within a session kept, context size flat
LRU and idle expiry work with the injected clock; concurrent sessions safe
ANSWER.md names the shared Agent with evidence
